name: Littlestone Dimension / $k$-Block Littlestone Dimension
details: Every $k$-block shattered tree is an ordinary shattered Littlestone tree.
proof: The $k$-block condition only restricts the coordinate labels allowed in an ordinarily shattered Littlestone tree. Thus every tree counted by $\mathrm B_k(\mathcal H)$ is counted by $\mathrm L(\mathcal H)$, and $\mathrm L(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm B_k(\mathcal H)$ for every $k\ge2$.
